source_note: mature nodule + root, protoplast scRNA-seq, used as pseudobulk
rejected_reason: snRNA-seq of early nodule; Lba ranks 45,386/52,594 with 668 counts against a median gene total of 2,496; 9-33 co-detected nuclei per Lb pair; the intended negative control Hb2 is the most abundant globin present
normalisation: CPM over summed library counts; no cell calling
metrics_emitted: log2 fold change mean and SD, all libraries and nodule only

log2fc.orientation: a over b, in the canonical label_a/label_b order
log2fc.pseudocount_reason: two of three contrast-tissue libraries are at exactly 0 CPM for every family member, so an unregularised ratio is 0/0 there
log2fc.pseudocount_scope_caveat: negligible for the high-expressed focal genes but not for members near the detection floor: fold changes involving those are regularised, not measured ratios
log2fc.sd_caveat: log2fc_sd_all is dominated by the inter-tissue step, not by variability in the ratio; log2fc_sd_nodule is over 2 libraries

metrics_degenerate.spearman_profile: 1.000 for all six focal pairs over 5 points; carries no information at this resolution

metrics_not_computable.detection_rate: per-cell quantity; pseudobulk has no cells
metrics_not_computable.coexpression_overlap: per-cell quantity; pseudobulk has no cells

tau_caveat: two tissue types only; tau collapses to a focal-vs-contrast contrast
